releases.body: Fixes prompt submission after selecting a home-screen directory. Removes the redundant session.cd dispatch and restores focus to the home prompt after the native Windows folder picker closes.\n\nInstall or update: `opencode2 plugin add opencode-choose-directory@latest`

Fixes first-prompt submission after selecting a home-screen directory. The plugin resolves and preloads the selected location's agent/model/provider catalogs before exposing the location to the composer.\n\nInstall or update: `opencode2 plugin add opencode-choose-directory@latest`

Moves the home-screen directory picker button to the far right of the prompt footer by targeting the outer `prompt.footer` slot.\n\nInstall or update: `opencode2 plugin add opencode-choose-directory@latest`

Documentation release adding the recommended one-command npm installation, manual configuration, GitHub source installation, update, and uninstall instructions.\n\nInstall: `opencode2 plugin add opencode-choose-directory`
